name: authnudge
description: Log an agent into a website by approving on your phone. Fills Chrome with remote debugging. Usernames and passwords never appear in chat.

AUTHNUDGE_TO.title: Authnudge email or handle
AUTHNUDGE_TO.description: Optional. Default recipient if login is called without `to`. Prefer passing `to` on the tool.

AUTHNUDGE_API_KEY.title: API key
AUTHNUDGE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Dashboard API key (an_…). If omitted, the agent generates a key pair and you paste the public SPKI under Access → Public keys.
